components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call to action button with champagne fill
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C5A880; color: #111317; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4b890; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #EAEFF5; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #C5A880; }

narrative.overview: A high-craft digital aesthetic defined by deep obsidian fields, solid slate containers, warm alabaster typography, and muted champagne gold accents.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp structural lines with squircle container geometry
Hairline borders with champagne gold hover feedback

rules.name: The Champagne Rarity Rule
rules.body: Champagne Gold (#C5A880) is restricted to ≤10% of any viewport.

dos: Do use hairline borders (border-white/5) for quiet structure.
donts: Don't add vibrant neon gradients or rainbow badges.
Don't use heavy blur glassmorphism or thick drop shadows.
